title: Pre-application conference
authority: City of Bremerton — Department of Community Development
body: Pre-application conference held with the City on the four-parcel assemblage, establishing the plat configuration, frontage improvement scope and open space requirements the June 2026 engineering set was drawn to.

title: Preliminary civil improvement plans signed
body: Signed preliminary plat map, site plan, storm and grading plan, phasing plan, profiles and sections, together with the geotechnical engineering report, storm drainage analysis and photometric plan.

title: SEPA checklist signed
authority: City of Bremerton — SEPA responsible official
body: Environmental checklist executed and submitted with the application package.

title: Preliminary plat and site development permit submitted
body: Full application filed: preliminary plat application, legal descriptions for all four parcels, signed civil improvement plans, geotechnical report, storm drainage analysis, traffic count by Heath & Associates, tree report, photometric plan, utility availability letter, architecture and unit mix. Currently under City review.

title: Preliminary plat approval
body: The seller's deliverable, and the closing condition on offer. Timing is at the City's discretion and is not warranted.

title: Civil construction permit
body: Post-approval conditions, final engineering and the civil construction permit pass to the buyer at closing.

title: Building permits
body: Vertical permitting on the buyer's plans and schedule. The architecture set for all thirty-eight homes conveys with the sale.
